data.long_description:
Provident is proud to present this spacious one bedroom residence at Dunya Tower

This residence offers privacy and luxury. The living and dining are beautifully furnished in light and neural tones. The bedroom features lush furniture and private ensuite bathroom offering you privacy and convenience.

The kitchen is a closed kitchen with direct balcony access and is fully equipped, all kitchen appliances included.

Dunya Tower offers direct access to the Dubai Mall and MBR Boulevard with an endless choice of retail, cafés and restaurant options. Dunya tower is the ultimate lifestyle tower at a competitive price.

The apartment:

- 1 bedroom
- 964.55 sq. ft (89.61 sq.m)
- Closed kitchen with direct balcony access
- Ensuite bathroom
- Separate powder room for guests
- Fully furnished (kitchen appliances included)

DIRECT ACCESS TO THE DUBAI MALL & MBR BOULEVARD

Amenities:

-Pool & Gym
-24/7 reception

DISCOVER DOWNTOWN DUBAI YOUR WAY AT DUNYA TOWER
